concepts.definition: The Product-owned accepted declaration of the shared frame set for finite actors collectively engaging one governed Product scope or outcome. It binds the exact method and optional profile, admitting authorities and scopes, frames and evaluations, actor rules and capabilities, semantic/evaluation/operation/decision grants, result/conjunction/translation/coverage relations, activation triggers, and invalidation law.

grounding.quote:
A **Project Reference-Frame Basis** is the Product-owned accepted declaration
of the shared frame set through which finite actors collectively engage one
governed Product scope or outcome.

concepts.label: Project Reference-Frame Basis

concepts.definition: An execution-scoped binding of one agent to an applicable frame declaration or active configuration, exact evaluation, subject, basis, evidence boundary, and capability envelope. Its activation packet belongs to a ticket or other authorized work instruction; it is distinct from the durable collective basis and from actor identity.

grounding.quote:
An **Agent Frame Activation**
is the execution-scoped binding of one agent to an applicable
frame declaration or active configuration, exact evaluation, subject, basis,
evidence boundary, and capability envelope.

concepts.label: Agent Frame Activation

concepts.definition: The common constitutional WHAT is a requirements calculus specifying admissible states, outcomes, constraints, evidence obligations, and permitted changes. Intent and Product each have one canonical entrypoint; specification may have multiple surfaces.

grounding.quote:
The common `WHAT` is the requirements calculus: it states admissible states,
outcomes, constraints, evidence obligations and permitted changes without
choosing every means of execution.

concepts.label: Constitutional WHAT

concepts.definition: A build tenant is one independent project-owned HOW realization of a common WHAT. Build tenancy is the one-or-more realization relation, with singleton and multiple-tenant cases. Tenant design supplies computational operations, composition, performers, effects, assumptions, and observation bindings. SPEC_METHOD owns urn:stdo:bounded-context:build-tenancy. The canonical how.build_tenants Tenant Registry gives stable identities and root/design/implementation locators; how.common binds realization law expressly adopted across multiple tenants.

grounding.quote:
A
**build tenant** is one such realization. **Build tenancy** is the one-or-more
relation; one tenant is its singleton case and multi-build-tenancy begins when
the same `WHAT` has more than one independent realization.

concepts.label: Build tenancy and tenant registry

concepts.definition: Recursive acquisition of stdo_*.json definitions throughout a selected workspace, including its root and arbitrarily deep project roots. Explicit directed composition carries a target locator, expected stable definition identity, relation authority, and one or more governing contracts; nesting itself supplies no relation.

grounding.quote:
Directory nesting creates no implicit inheritance, ownership, composition, or
constitutional override. Parent and child definitions remain independent until
`composition` explicitly relates them.

concepts.label: Definition discovery and composition

concepts.definition: Context-bound concept resolution under an exact selected basis, covering uniquely resolved use and material collisions. Local resolution identifies one context and exactly one concept; cross-context resolution supplies a complete authorized relation.

grounding.quote:
A positive local case declares one context and resolves exactly one concept. A
positive cross-context case supplies the complete authorized relation.

concepts.label: Semantic resolution

concepts.definition: One complete released STDO method version with exact membership, member digests, review basis, human acceptance, and immutable identity. Authorship is modular, each law has one owning standard, and authority is singular. Derived, authoring, evidential, and installed surfaces do not constitute selectable partial constitutions.

grounding.quote:
The shared methodology is modular in authorship and singular in authority.
Each law has one owning standard; other standards consume it by reference. The
standards become operative only as one complete released STDO version.

concepts.label: Released method cut

concepts.definition: The homeostatic chain Goals → Intent → Product Definition → Requirements → Design → Realisation → Observations → Projection → Delta → Scenarios → Gap Analysis → intake-selected re-entry or observation. Goals set current work concerns; Intent sets direction; Product Definition names mutable-project terms, boundaries, realization and end-state shape; Requirements state invariant truths; Design supplies structural decisions; Realisation carries them; Observations establish bounded actual state; Projection answers a declared question; Delta reveals drift; Scenarios exercise operational meaning; Gap Analysis identifies insufficiency.

grounding.quote:
Goals → Intent → Product Definition → Requirements → Design → Realisation → Observations → Projection → Delta
                                                                                       ↓
                                                                                  Scenarios
                                                                                       ↓
                                                                                Gap Analysis
                                                                                       ↓
                                                                  Intake-selected re-entry or observation

concepts.label: Constitutional chain

concepts.definition: A bounded execution-control surface for batching, coordination, proof-cost management, and close review under existing constitutional authority. Deferred compliance is escrow. Sprint close is forensic reconciliation, distinct from automatic approval.

grounding.quote:
A sprint is a bounded execution-control surface.

It is not a new layer in the constitutional chain.

concepts.label: Sprint

concepts.definition: SPEC_METHOD's substrate-neutral ambiguity-governance context distinguishes major ambiguity affecting realization law from micro ambiguity within governed design. Lawful Probabilistic Processing is policy-permitted bounded non-human handling; Human Adjudication is authority-admitted explicit human judgment required by policy or risk appetite. Resolved, carried forward, escalated, and blocked are handling states, separate from claim verdicts.

grounding.quote:
**Lawful Probabilistic Processing**
(`urn:stdo:concept:ambiguity-governance:lawful-probabilistic-processing`) is
bounded non-human processing permitted by declared policy to carry or resolve
declared ambiguity. **Human Adjudication**
(`urn:stdo:concept:ambiguity-governance:human-adjudication`) is explicit human
judgment admitted by authority to resolve declared ambiguity where policy or
risk appetite requires it.

concepts.label: Ambiguity governance

concepts.definition: Every material product, application, module, graph function, runtime/plugin/public/data surface, or capability has an operational lifecycle: intent → requirement → build → assurance → release → deployment → live usage → observed telemetry → retirement.

grounding.quote:
Any material product, application, module, graph function, runtime surface,
plugin surface, public interface, data surface, or capability has an operational
lifecycle.

concepts.label: Operational lifecycle

concepts.definition: The single intake route for substantive change, independent of whether a report is called bug, feature request, issue, regression, operator finding, release blocker, or scenario failure. It diagnoses impact and selects a lawful change class and constitutional re-entry boundary without itself granting mutation.

grounding.quote:
There is one front door for substantive change.

The intake label does not determine the process class.

concepts.label: Universal intake triage

conditions: Assurance or intake requires causal diagnosis of a counterexample on a declared path.

Its exclusive forms are a unique locus, a jointly necessary set of incomparable earliest loci, unresolved alternative frontiers, or indeterminate bounded localization.
exceptions: It does not add a separate pass to every change.

grounding.quote:
A testing counterexample is returned to its earliest supported causal frontier
on the declared path. The frontier contains the causally minimal violated owner
relations or seam coordinates established by the evidence; earliest means
minimal under the declared causal relation, not first in log or clock order.

concepts.label: Counterexample localization

concepts.definition: Reusable intake classification with C for reproducible facts and declared rule application, J for residual semantic/materiality judgment, and O for an actual owner's reserved ruling. These annotations introduce neither authority nor a calculus kind, runtime, classifier interface, or mandatory document.

grounding.quote:
`C` denotes reproducible facts and declared
rule application; `J` denotes residual semantic or materiality judgment; `O`
denotes a ruling reserved to its actual owner. These annotations grant no
authority and introduce no calculus kind, runtime, classifier interface, or
mandatory document.

concepts.label: Computed classification and treatment

concepts.definition: Closure of a declared change span evaluates the conjunction of all applicable obligations and required judgments or rulings, with no active non-closure condition. This closure predicate is distinct from a local artifact's fitness.

grounding.quote:
Closure of a declared change span applies
[Contract application](TRANSFORMATION_LIBRARY.md#contract-application) to reliance
on its closure evidence, then evaluates the conjunction of all applicable
obligations and required judgments or rulings, with no active non-closure
condition.

concepts.label: Consistency gate

concepts.definition: An explicitly selected unresolved, directly verifiable Product-defined outcome instance with a declared acceptance interval. Material advance, prerequisite readiness, preservation, and regression are progress annotations, each distinguished from predicate verdicts. A bounded prerequisite enables a named Product obligation; a bounded experiment supplies a stated observation discriminating a stated decision.

grounding.quote:
Every Product-outcome-bearing work wave identifies one explicitly selected,
unresolved, directly verifiable Product-defined outcome and declares the
acceptance interval for that instance. Product-progress claims and promotion
onto the supported Product path are judged against that same outcome.

concepts.label: Product outcome instance and bounded enabling work

concepts.definition: The relation between semantic ambiguity removed and effective reasoning complexity introduced. Complexity includes independent concepts and authorities, cross-document joins, branching, states, transitions, reconciliation, and decision detail; it is not raw lines, artifacts, or context-window size.

grounding.quote:
Proportionality is the relation between semantic ambiguity removed and
effective reasoning complexity introduced. A method obligation is proportional
when its contraction of the admissible interpretation space justifies the
additional concepts, relations, projections, and evidence that an agent must
hold together to reach a correct decision.

concepts.label: Method proportionality

Candidate availability and preservation assessment are distinct claims.

accepted governing basis

  -> selected computational relations
  -> delegated execution and decision authority
  -> construction and self-review
  -> independent live-surface assessment where required

concepts.label: Agentic construction execution

concepts.definition: The smallest coherent causal dependency cone capable of delivering the selected behavior while preserving every affected governing relation. Material seams follow causal support, rather than function, file, module, ticket, or document boundaries.

grounding.quote:
the
smallest coherent causal dependency cone capable of delivering the selected
behavior while preserving every affected governing relation. Its material seams
follow that condition, not function, file, module, ticket or document boundaries.

concepts.label: Causal construction cone

concepts.definition: Assessment of whether an exact candidate closes its declared cone and preserves every affected governing relation. It yields evidence and a proposed semantic disposition; application of a disposition is a separate authority-bound decision, retaining its own predicate and result.

grounding.quote:
Assessment evaluates the exact predicate `the candidate closes its declared
cone and preserves every affected governing relation` through the shared
[result algebra](FOUNDATIONS.md#result-algebra). It returns evidence and a
proposed semantic disposition. Apply [Dispose](TRANSFORMATION_LIBRARY.md#dispose)
to the separate decision on that proposal, using this section's construction
conditions and the existing authority's bound mandate.

concepts.label: Cone assessment and disposition

concepts.definition: Acceptance binds an exact checkpoint. A preservation checkpoint instead retains unfinished or unaccepted work under an existing exact grant. Continuation operates on the continuing workspace; churn annotates rejected or superseded construction history and cost, rather than Product movement or noncompliance.

grounding.quote:
A preservation checkpoint may retain unfinished or unaccepted work under an
existing exact operation grant. Identify its parent or predecessor, included
territory, concurrent-writer disposition and durable evidence location. It is
neither acceptance, promotion nor publication.

concepts.label: Checkpoint, continuation, and churn

conditions: A consequential transition and actual admission owners are present.
concepts.definition: UP-021 admission of an exact complete material transition over every participant and equality join affecting or affected by identity, validity, authority, currentness, or transition. Admission assessment, authorized admission/refusal/re-entry decision, actual semantic commit, atomicity, and form applicability are separate claims. Original outcomes admitted, refused, and effect-free re-entry are retained.

grounding.quote:
Its support universe is
every participant and equality join whose identity, validity, authority,
currentness or transition can affect or be affected by admission. The owner
independently derives and validates that relation from authoritative inputs;
the shared Support condition governs crossing seams and independence claims.

concepts.label: Complete enclosing-relation admission

concepts.definition: Qualification instantiated for every admission owner and supported boundary declared by accepted design, with case applicability determined by the supported inputs, states, and operating/threat model. Cases test admission, applicability, or publication through the owning result map.

grounding.quote:
Qualification is instantiated for every admission owner and supported boundary
declared by accepted design. Case applicability follows the supported input,
state and operating/threat model.

concepts.label: Standing structural qualification

concepts.definition: A shared contract or carrier materially governing runtime closure, reporting/status truth, topology/frame progression, proof/qualification, event/projection semantics, identity/binding resolution, or provider/resolver behavior. Changes affecting how multiple surfaces determine current truth are core-interface changes.

grounding.quote:
If changing the interface can alter how multiple surfaces decide "what is true
now," it is a core interface change.

concepts.label: Core interface

concepts.definition: Constitutional migration of a load-bearing shared interface. Inside-Out Hard-Break replaces authoritative truth in place on the same implementation line, proceeding outward through breaks and repairs. Fundamental Re-Adoption re-derives a major rewrite on a materially different implementation basis and moves the predecessor aside as reference material. Bounded evolution is a rebuttable strategy-selection presumption, not a third strategy.

grounding.quote:
- **Inside-Out Hard-Break Migration**: use this when the project remains on the
  same implementation line and the authoritative source truth is being replaced
  in place. The work proceeds from source carrier outward through a sequence of
  deliberate breaks and repairs.
- **Fundamental Re-Adoption Migration**: use this when the rewrite is major and
  the project is intentionally re-deriving itself on a materially different
  implementation basis, such as a new runtime model, carrier model, type
  system, execution substrate, or realization tree. The prior implementation is
  moved sideways and treated as reference material, not live authority.

concepts.label: Constitutional migration

concepts.definition: A witness for an exact subject, intended property, and governing basis. The claim owner supplies the property and scope; the authorized evaluator supplies evidence. Proof-target identity, weaker-property exclusion, semantic/evidence/projection separation, and assurance-boundary qualification are distinct source-defined evidence obligations.

grounding.quote:
The claim owner supplies the property and required scope; the
authorized evaluator supplies evidence, not a substitute target.

concepts.label: Constitutional proof

concepts.definition: Semantic basis means the constitutional and accepted-design relations defining a claim. Evidence basis means the exact artifacts, events, logs, tests, and observations evaluating it. State projection means a current view derived from admitted semantic and evidence bases.

grounding.quote:
- **semantic basis**: constitutional and accepted-design relations defining
  what a claim means;
- **evidence basis**: exact artifacts, events, logs, tests, and observations
  used to evaluate it; and
- **state projection**: a current view derived from admitted semantic and
  evidence bases.

concepts.label: Semantic basis, evidence basis, and state projection

concepts.definition: Assurance of the authoritative composite subject through an ordinary assurance path. Generic method sufficiency qualification uses a fresh competent constructor in a declared capability/context/configuration envelope, a frozen construction, and independently authorized evaluation against a declared governing semantic basis and comparison predicate.

grounding.quote:
A fresh competent
constructor operates inside a declared capability, context, and configuration
envelope using only the declared ordinary method and authority surfaces. An
independently authorized evaluator has a declared governing basis and comparison
predicate.

concepts.label: Assurance-boundary congruence and method qualification

concepts.definition: Concrete end-to-end product-owner use cases testing the chain from intent to realized operational behavior. Scenario bundles or equivalent ordered testcases make a feature boundary, coherent sequence, and significant-step expected outcomes inspectable.

grounding.quote:
Scenarios are the product-owner layer. They are concrete, end-to-end use cases
that test the chain from intent to realized behavior.

concepts.label: Operational scenarios and bundles

concepts.definition: SPEC_METHOD's product-assurance taxonomy separates design/module conformance authority from constitutional UAT/acceptance authority, independently of execution breadth. Unit names design/module scope; integration names breadth; sandbox names composed-product acceptance; harnessed/fake/recorded/deterministic name non-live sandbox execution; live requires a real external worker or transport boundary.

grounding.quote:
Authority source is not the same thing as execution breadth. A test may be
small or broad, fast or slow, deterministic or live, but it still derives from
one of two primary authorities:

1. **Design/module conformance tests**
2. **UAT / acceptance tests**

concepts.label: Test authority taxonomy

concepts.definition: External project evidence used by a proof lane, whose source/version/acquisition binding and availability are distinguished from the Product property being evaluated.

grounding.quote:
Missing external fixtures must fail with a governed diagnostic that names the
fixture authority and lane. They must not masquerade as product semantic failure.

concepts.label: Proof fixture

concepts.definition: Four constitutional requirement categories: Capability supplies behavior/function/surface; Constraint or Guarantee bounds behavior by invariants, laws, safety, portability, or semantic guarantees; Governance controls lifecycle, authority, visibility, release, or operator action; Verification governs tests, evidence, traceability, qualification, or forensic surfaces. Categories classify truth, not priority or user visibility.

grounding.quote: Requirements remain part of the constitutional layer in all four cases. A category is not a priority label and not a claim that the requirement is user-facing. It is a statement of what kind of project truth the requirement owns.

concepts.label: Requirement categories

concepts.definition: Sufficiency of ordered reconstruction by a competent team: Goals to conformant Intent; Intent to Product; Product to Requirements; Requirements to Design; Requirements plus Design to Realization in the selected environment. The criterion is reconstructability, not unique derivation or determinism.

grounding.quote:
This does not mean the derivation is unique. Different designs may satisfy the
same requirements, and different software, human or mixed realizations may
satisfy the same design. The test is sufficiency, not determinism.

concepts.label: Reconstruction litmus

concepts.definition: The structural HOW choosing concrete mechanisms, interfaces, topology, file placement, carriers, entry/control surfaces, runtime wiring, and lawful tenant boundaries. ADRs are durable design records rather than an additional constitutional layer. Stack, carrier, and runtime selection belong here when upstream constitutional truth has not already constrained them.

grounding.quote:
Design decides the concrete mechanism that realizes them.

If a technology stack, carrier, or runtime is not already constrained by an
upstream constitutional surface, choosing it is part of design rather than a
separate upstream authority.

concepts.label: Structural design

grounding.quote:
The JSON

constraints.statement: reference_frame_bases is non-empty; each locator identifies an accepted declaration, every admitting lawful authority, and its exact governed scope. The declaration owns its selected frames, method/profile, outcome, actor rules, capabilities, grants, triggers, coverage, results, and invalidation. Reference Frame Method supplies principles and the baseline supplies only an optional profile; neither adopts or owns Product bindings. Method-cut inclusion makes a profile available, Product authority alone adopts it, and only an exact authorized instruction activates a bound frame for an actor and subject. Activation does not mutate the Product overlay, which neither registers agents nor assigns permanent frames nor persists temporary configurations. Actors and frames remain distinct; names and broad frames confer no authority beyond cited owners and exact activation. For cross-Product outcomes, record a Product-role map distinguishing Source Projects, Product Definitions, candidate checkpoints, Release Cuts, released Products, Installs, Artifacts, and dependents; Development Product is a role on an exact Install. Every directed composition edge states source/target roles, authority/contracts, lifecycle, evidence boundary, refusal, and invalidation. Shared actors, repositories, files, implementations, outputs, or access create no identity/composition relation. A carrier named Frame remains under its WHAT/HOW and enters the frame set only through explicit declaration with required evaluation and authority relations.

grounding.quote:
At design admission, each affected requirement identifies its realising
operation or invariant, the preservation obligation at its interfaces, and the
evidence capable of defeating the claimed realisation. The binding preserves
applicable authority, required human decisions, independence, failure and
recovery conditions; a convenient execution environment cannot weaken them.

constraints.statement: Each design-admitted affected requirement identifies its realizing operation/invariant, interface preservation obligation, and defeating evidence. Bindings preserve authority, required human decisions, independence, failure and recovery; material context, time, memory, communication, human effort, and spend have units and declared measurement boundaries. Context fit and attention adequacy have distinct referenced evidence conditions; categorical preservation additionally invokes Orthogonal descriptions. A requirement-operation route does not establish preservation or fitness. Tenants cannot silently change common WHAT. Author identity, actor identity, and operation kind remain distinct; a human procedure is not thereby adjudication, and a_c neither selects an executor nor proves conformance through structural validation. what.intent/what.product each locate one canonical entrypoint; what.specification may locate multiple surfaces. Registry entries have stable identity and root/design/implementation locators; a separate TENANT_REGISTRY.md is only companion/projection, never competing identity/location authority. ticketing.goals locates the work wave; tickets locates durable root and at least backlog/active/completed lanes; comments locates commentary; sprints optionally locates batch manifests. Goals own work-wave scope, ticket state retains ticket authority, and comments are non-authoritative.

grounding.quote:
Resolution verifies both locator and expected identity. Moving a definition
requires a locator update but does not change its identity. Replacing content
at the same locator with another definition identity fails closed. When an edge
binds exact immutable Product or release versions, the cited relation and
contracts also carry and verify those identities; the mutable definition
identity cannot substitute for them.

constraints.statement: Discover definitions recursively within the selected workspace. Each composition entry declares product_definition locator, target_definition_id matching the target's product.definition_id, directed relation authority defining roles/owner/scope/lifecycle/invalidators, and non-empty exact governing contracts. Resolve both location and identity; movement updates location without changing identity; replacement by a different identity at the same location fails closed. Immutable Product/release identities must additionally be carried and verified when bound. Every discovered definition validates against its selected released schema; required URIs/fragments resolve within declared workspace/resolver boundaries; definition IDs are globally unique in the set and tenant IDs unique per overlay; every governed scope has an applicable resolvable frame basis, with overlaps reconciled by cited authority. Every local disambiguation binds exact term/context/complete material candidates/selection/authority/basis/scope, selects a member of disambiguates, and has a congruent resolution carrier. Every material cross-context seam has explicit import/disambiguation/translation/equivalence rather than nominal matching. Every composition target, relation and contract resolves. No two carriers claim authority for the same Product, tenant, ticket state, or constitutional relation. Draft 2020-12 schema checks structural shape; URI formats are annotations unless asserted. Conformance separately requires assertion-capable RFC 3986 syntax checking, resolution, fragment existence, selected-release identity, cross-file uniqueness, constitutional sufficiency, semantic/cross-context completeness, and authority congruence.

Without explicit cross-context relation, evaluation Frame and consumer runtime Frame remain distinct and nominal match cannot enroll the latter; specialist Owner evaluation family gains no semantic/decision owner authority; immutable Product and mutable Product Definition remain distinct and selection follows occurrence context; STDO build Tenant supplies no default for hosted/customer/account/runtime/data tenancy; User remains unresolved among Product role/person/principal/account/actor/operator/data subject until downstream authority defines or relates meanings. conditions: Within a derived instruction's declared scope.
exceptions: A concrete form is method law when the method explicitly accepts it as an interoperability boundary.
STDO Product scope may expand to concrete executable systems only with separate explicit human authorization.

grounding.quote:
Within their declared scope, derived instructions preserve the owning clauses'
applicability, obligations, permissions, exclusions, decision owners and
invalidators. A projected prohibition cannot lose its condition or lawful
alternative even when every source digest is correct. A summary, bootstrap or
index cannot require a stricter or weaker relation by compression. Its
references must be resolvable within the declared actor's access; otherwise the
required meaning is supplied directly.

constraints.statement: A view cannot change meaning or authority under a selected constitution. Release authority admits one complete released cut, each law has one owner, and standards operate only as that complete version. Compressions, templates, comments, candidates, installs, and mutable source cannot form partial constitutions or reinterpret owners. Derived instructions preserve applicability, obligations, permissions, exclusions, owners, invalidators, conditional prohibitions and lawful alternatives; compression cannot strengthen or weaken relations even with correct digests. References must be accessible to the declared actor or their required meaning supplied directly. STDO owns normative algebra, authority, abstract states/transitions, admissibility, causal order, and evidence invariants; consumers own concrete types/schemas/files/tools/runtime/orchestration/tests/executable conformance. Shared-method amendments do not independently authorize executable tools, engines, runtimes, assurance systems, or consumer realization as STDO Product scope. Recording a ruling cannot widen its subject, implication, authority, or change class. Only released versions supply publication authority; mutable source may author a future cut but cannot silently govern consumers.
