exceptions: A realization path is fixed by requirements when the path itself is constitutional.

grounding.quote:
The workspace persists through this loop. At each activation, current material
state and valid authority define the new A; Z names the admitted acceptance
constraints. The actor acquires sufficient context for the next bounded
transition. Discarding that context does not rewind A. A new observation can
invalidate a belief or dependent result; it cannot silently change Z or create
permission. Revising Z follows the owning re-entry relation below.

constraints.statement: Downstream success requires adequate upstream meaning and traceable authority. Goals/Product owners select outcomes; Design may choose any constrained realization, without unique implementation derivation. Every chain link is load-bearing: missing repricing paths, unowned requirements, ungrounded design, or realization without design create accidental law. ADRs are design records. Realisation includes software and performed human procedures; events are optional durable observation carriers. Projection is checked against sources/current state, creates no second truth, and does not require universal full-event replay. Repricing follows intake's owning layer and affected span; a constitutional gap does not itself require new Goals/Intent, and unresolved causes may require observation. Current material state and valid authority define A; Z is admitted acceptance constraints. Acquire sufficient bounded-transition context; losing context does not rewind state, and observations neither silently change Z nor create permission. GOALS.md contains temporary work-wave focus until intentionally repriced; PRODUCT.md describes the current mutable source project, not immutable RC artifact or installed Product. Requirements include capabilities, invariants, constraints, governance and verification; Design chooses realization details. Independently of physical layout, what locates shared WHAT, how.build_tenants locates one or more HOWs, and tenant-local realization remains derivative until truth is ratified in specification.
constraints.uncertainty: The referenced recursive Product taxonomy and foundational premises are outside this excerpt.

grounding.quote:
Deferred compliance inside a sprint is escrow, not acceptance. It cannot satisfy
method, release, or product closure until it is paid down, explicitly accepted
under the governing method, or repriced into the appropriate upstream surface.

constraints.statement: A sprint cannot create, supersede, weaken, or override existing Goals/Intent/Product/Requirements/Design authority. A lawful sprint states its goal/work wave, upstream authority, admitted scope, excluded Product/requirement/design/runtime/data-contract/governance boundaries, expected change classes, any deferrable local proof/compliance debt, closure trigger/law, and debt paydown/repricing path. Deferred proof optimization is lawful only when local, visible, bounded, and repayable. Escrow satisfies no method/release/Product closure until paid down, explicitly accepted under the governing method, or repriced upstream. Close may be recommended, rather than automatically required, upon timebox expiry, completed scope, review becoming cheaper than accumulated iteration, unsafe review uncertainty, or gaps outgrowing the sprint boundary. Close compares work/evidence to authority, classifies each gap, accepts compliant work, opens local paydown, and escalates authority drift. Discovery of any Product-truth change is not landing authorization: split, escalate, reprice, or explicitly carry paydown under governing law. Ticket Method owns mechanics; domain refinements may determine appropriate escrow optimization.
constraints.uncertainty: Ticket and domain refinement mechanics are not supplied.

grounding.quote: Ambiguity detection is mandatory. Blocking is policy.

Admissibility and fulfillment of the interrupted task remain separate
predicates: refusal alone does not establish that the intended outcome failed.
An unusable governing
basis or an evaluation outside capability retains its own diagnosis. The stop
label proves neither non-performance nor absence of effects; an undeclared or
uncertain effect needs actual observation before dependent action.

constraints.statement: Unsupported material meaning cannot become established result or permission. Graph-native F_D/F_P/F_H shorthands remain in their ODD context unless explicitly imported/translated. Goals, Intent, Product, Requirements, tenant/stack choice, Design, and implementation progressively narrow different ambiguities. Major ambiguity materially changes architecture, stack, Product boundary, execution/deployment admissibility, public contract, or downstream law; micro ambiguity stays within governed design. Always surface/govern major ambiguity, never hide it in operator judgment, precedent, or model choice. At each major boundary record remaining/new ambiguity, affected invariant/asset/decision boundary, decision if proceeding, and handling state. Declared risk policy determines carry/resolve/escalate thresholds; either risk appetite still requires recording ambiguity and decisions. On 'ambiguity is resolved', established resolution is satisfied, established remaining ambiguity falsified, insufficient evidence indeterminate. Independently, lawful policy-and-authority handling is satisfied, demonstrated violation falsified, unsupported handling indeterminate. Both retain invalid_basis/out_of_frame diagnoses and neither settles delivery or extends authority. Hard stops regardless of risk appetite include violated invariants/guarantees, absent required authority, missing declared operational capability, undeclared irreversible effects, and explicit human-approval gates. Witnessed violation or unmet required authorization falsifies corresponding admissibility; missing evidence leaves it indeterminate. Fulfillment remains separate; refusal proves neither failed outcome, non-performance, nor no effects. Observe undeclared/uncertain effects before dependent action. The policy requires visible, governed, progressively reduced ambiguity, not eliminating all ambiguity before work.
constraints.uncertainty: Core stop/result law and declared Product risk policy are referenced but not instantiated.

conditions: Lifecycle aspects materially affect the designed thing's meaning.
exceptions: A phase may be inapplicable with an explicit reason.
A requirement may defer a phase only by naming deferment and its later resolution owner.

grounding.quote:
When the lifecycle signal is missing, downstream design may not fill the gap by
local convention, implementation precedent, prompt prose, or test fixture. It
must reprice the appropriate constitutional surface or carry the ambiguity as
explicit, governed debt.

constraints.statement: Constitutional specification extends beyond build shape. Product and requirements supply enough signal to derive intended lifecycle or explicitly record unresolved ambiguity; detailed mechanisms for every phase are not required. Product names boundary, use context, release/install, live use, observability, and retirement/supersession posture where material. Requirements state applicable invariant obligations over build, assurance, release, deployment, usage, telemetry, retirement, ownership, source truth, authority, and interpretation. Unknown phases have named gaps such as Gap: or Unanswered:; silent absence is invalid. This is an ambiguity detector, not a demand for every requirement to be a release plan. Missing signal requires constitutional repricing or explicit governed debt; design cannot invent it from convention, precedent, prompt prose, or fixtures.

conditions: Every substantive change.

grounding.quote:
Every substantive change begins with intake triage, an explicit declared change
intent, and a lawful re-entry point into the constitutional chain.

constraints.statement: Begin with intake triage, explicit declared change intent, and lawful constitutional re-entry.

grounding.quote:
No bug, feature, issue, or other intake may bypass this triage by going
straight to code, tests, or release handling.

constraints.statement: Triage determines substantiveness, affected Product/scope, lawful class/re-entry, downstream surfaces/evidence requiring repricing/re-derivation/re-proof, and release-scope fit or release-plan repricing. No label bypasses triage. Diagnose defective realization, inadequate requirement/design, inaccurate prediction, or insufficient observation against current subject/outcome/observations/model; unresolved alternatives may select further observation. Severity is consequence, priority is order within mandate; neither alters diagnosis or grants repair. Across applicable frames use the same subject/basis, material variables, governing relations and evidence, preserving alternatives and identifying smallest sufficient repair. The exposing frame need not contain the cause; renaming repeated analysis adds no evidence. Bind exact report, sources, observations, retained results and assessment grant; reuse depends on currentness. Select smallest sufficient applicable configuration with causal localization where required, without prescribing reviewer count or rounds and without weakening independence/repair authority. Minimum classes: goal_reprice changes work-wave focus at Goals and may propagate deeper where truth changes; intent_reprice changes direction/scope at Intent through Product/Requirements/Design/Realisation/Evidence; product_reprice changes realization with stable intent at Product through Requirements/Design/Realisation/Evidence; requirement_reprice changes truth with stable direction at Requirements through Design/Realisation/Evidence; design_reframe changes structure with stable intent/requirements at Design through Realisation/Evidence; realization_refactor changes local implementation/procedure/configuration/attributes without intended constitutional/structural change, enters realized surface only and proves no upstream drift. Lower-than-Goals re-entry requires explicit assertion of no upstream constitutional change. Missing declared class is process drift.
constraints.uncertainty: Shared diagnosis, applicability, currentness, and core result contracts are external references.

conditions: Causal diagnosis is required on a declared path supplied by Product/design owners.

grounding.quote:
The evaluated predicate is `the evidence establishes this stated earliest
causal frontier for this counterexample`. A supported unique locus or jointly
necessary set maps to `satisfied` on that predicate. Unresolved alternatives,
an unsupported bounded frontier or a missing required reason maps to
`indeterminate`. Independently admissible evidence defeating the claimed
frontier gives `falsified`; an uninterpretable subject/causal basis gives
`invalid_basis`; diagnosis outside the evaluation scope/capability gives
`out_of_frame`.

constraints.statement: Localization records subject, basis, frontier form/members, causal evidence, expected relations, observed counterexample, and invalidated downstream claims. Do not collapse a jointly necessary incomparable set to an arbitrary owner or report alternatives as joint cause. On the stated-earliest-frontier predicate, supported unique or jointly necessary frontiers are satisfied; unresolved alternatives, unsupported bounded frontier, or missing required reason are indeterminate; admissible defeating evidence is falsified; uninterpretable subject/causal basis is invalid_basis; scope/capability excess is out_of_frame. Retain actual performance/effects. Localization satisfaction neither overwrites the original counterexample result nor proves repair. It grants no repair authority, broader test expansion, compatibility repair, new controller, or reinterpretation of unchanged upstream meaning; changes follow existing re-entry.
constraints.uncertainty: The adopted profile, declared path, and complete core result contract are not supplied.

exceptions: A rename preserves identity only when its owner supplies an identity-preserving relation.

grounding.quote:
C records its producer and procedure
revision, inputs, result, scope, source routes, reproduction relation, unknowns
and invalidators. Missing candidate or evidence is an input state.

constraints.statement: Bind exact request/outcome, targets/effects, operation grant/lifetime, Product Definition/basis, baseline/available candidate, declared relations, accepted design, traces, evidence and rules. C records producer/procedure revision, inputs, result, scope, routes, reproduction, unknowns and invalidators. Expose authority traversal through source/ownership/dependency/composition/projection declarations: reached layers/owners/bases, changed/unchanged/unknown relations, edges and unresolved frontier; root/authority/grant changes remain material even with equal Public bytes, and uncertain materiality remains J. Public delta enumerates the complete relevant serialized universe including helper/generated dependencies, additions/removals and every retained changed typed value/byte with exact before/after values; rename defaults to removal/addition. Missing candidate, incomplete enumeration, ambiguous identity, or unavailable projection makes affected delta unknown; membership equality is insufficient for value equality. Join changed bytes/relations to accepted scope/traces/acceptance evidence, distinguishing covered/missing/stale/ambiguous/outside-scope; filenames/artifact lists/digests alone establish no coverage. Current traces are C, residual semantic sufficiency J. Apply only declared rules with sufficient facts, recording owners/predicates/consequences and smallest lawful re-entry, next action, evidence/assessment, reserved ruling and carrier lifetime; retain conflicts/missing premises. Labels or filenames cannot route; do not invent J when rules settle the question.
constraints.uncertainty: External Support and Currentness semantics are not reproduced.

grounding.quote:
| `the exact relation/member differs from its predecessor` | `changed`: authenticated difference | `satisfied` |
| same delta predicate | `unchanged`: complete comparison establishes equality | `falsified` |
| same delta predicate | `unknown`: missing candidate, incomplete enumeration or unavailable comparison | `indeterminate` |
| `accepted design covers this exact changed relation` | `covered`: current accepted scope, trace and acceptance establish coverage | `satisfied` |
| same coverage predicate | `missing` or `outside-scope`: complete evidence establishes absence or exclusion from accepted scope | `falsified` |
| same coverage predicate | `missing`, `stale` or `ambiguous`: support does not decide current coverage | `indeterminate` |

constraints.statement: Comparison/coverage scope may include any supported state, including no change/no candidate. Difference predicate: authenticated changed is satisfied; complete equality is falsified; unavailable/incomplete comparison is indeterminate. Coverage predicate: current accepted scope/trace/acceptance is satisfied; complete established absence or exclusion is falsified; missing/stale/ambiguous undeciding support is indeterminate. Both retain invalid_basis for unusable subject/basis and out_of_frame for evaluation scope/capability, distinct from design exclusion. Missing reason is indeterminate while retaining independent counterevidence. C/J/O and change classes are annotations/treatments; treatment evaluates named rule premises, and ruling application has a separate decision predicate. Delta/nonconformance does not itself require changing law: if contract remains sufficient, reject or locally repair within grant; otherwise explicitly selected changed meaning or established insufficiency re-enters the actual owner. C needs sufficient premises, unresolved meaning/necessity is J, reserved decisions O; candidate behavior cannot author law. Unknown treatment withholds dependent reliance/promotion, although an existing bounded construction/evidence grant may authorize a cheapest useful discriminator, including first candidate, within subject/territory/operations/stops and without conformance claim. Correct mistaken routing at smallest affected owner. Reuse binds request/candidate/basis/root-owner/projection/design trace-acceptance/rule/configuration/evidence; refresh affected results before reliance, preserving predecessor/successor, original cause/attempted subject, effects, surviving facts and J dependencies. Recompute wider frontier when independence is unproved; Ticket Method owns carrier and J/O continuity.
constraints.uncertainty: No actual classification, premise set, ruling, or Currentness evaluation is performed.

grounding.quote:
A review event, passing aggregate, completed artifact or status change does not
discharge a missing required predicate in that conjunction.

constraints.statement: No gate closes with internally inconsistent affected active surfaces. Closure requires supported closure evidence, all applicable obligations/judgments/rulings, and no active non-closure condition. Upstream remains sufficient, downstream does not contradict active upstream truth, and tests/qualification prove active intended behavior rather than stale precedent. Reviews, aggregate passes, artifacts and status changes cannot discharge missing predicates. Shared Result governs conjunction; artifact fitness is separate. Ticket Method owns state/reuse carriers; workspace/context owns claim applicability. Code/test mismatch treats implementation as evidence, not authority, and is reconciled through admitted ticket, triage, lawful re-entry and governing requirement/design/module/graph/carrier/closure surface; ticket-local test-case authority is external.
constraints.uncertainty: Ticket Method and foundational conjunction/applicability details are not supplied.

conditions: Within a Product-outcome-bearing work wave.
exceptions: Explicitly defined assurance capability can itself be Product behavior; its delivery is assessed for progress while evidence remains non-authoring.

grounding.quote:
Only material advance projects
Product progress. Prerequisite work names the Product obligation it enables
and remains bounded.

Ended authority cannot be renewed by repair, continuation, evidence, active
ticket or run state, or prior admission; further material work requires a new
admission by the owning authority or its explicitly bounded proxy.

constraints.statement: Select one unresolved directly verifiable Product outcome and acceptance interval; progress/promotion use that instance. On material-advance predicate, established advance is satisfied; prerequisite-only, preservation-only and observed regression are falsified; unmeasured/undecidable movement is indeterminate with basis/scope diagnoses. Readiness/preservation may separately satisfy. Acceptance exhausts only the exact instance/interval, retaining witnesses for regression/preservation and not discharging enduring/recurring/broader obligations. Later work is preservation, a named bounded prerequisite for another admitted outcome, or repriced new change, never more progress on the accepted instance. Selecting an already-defined next outcome is Goals sequencing; new meaning/scope/outcome requires Product re-entry. Evidence artifacts cannot select/enlarge/replace outcomes; dual Product-output/evidence roles must be separately declared. Material growth derives from the unresolved outcome, admitted named bounded prerequisite, or admitted named bounded experiment with stated decision-discriminating observation. Provisional bounds confer no downstream work, promotion, closure, enlarged outcome, or waiver of Prime/design/safety/authority/release law. Work-wave owner or explicitly bounded proxy admits/renews through durable Goals/ticket authority with bound and exhaustion/falsification conditions. Experiment observation satisfaction exhausts it. Ticket/contract drafting, validation, active status and prior admission cannot create/extend/renew authority. Acceptance, prerequisite discharge, experimental decision resolution, other admitted terminal conditions, rejection, withdrawal, supersession, repricing-away or evidence falsification end the basis; new material work needs new owner/proxy admission. Retention grants no growth; consumer deletion/archive/quarantine/salvage carries only explicitly re-adopted semantics, not enclosing authority/dependencies/completion/work selection. Regression/unresolved gaps block affected-path promotion until repaired/repriced/owner-accepted; independently admitted parallel work may continue but cannot count as that outcome's progress. Outcome success is necessary evidence, not complete Product/release closure.
constraints.uncertainty: The work-wave admission and Product outcome are source-defined categories, not instantiated here.

grounding.quote:
Each constraint must identify the semantic ambiguity it
removes and must contract enough of the admissible interpretation space to
justify the reasoning complexity it introduces.

constraints.statement: Each constraint identifies removed semantic ambiguity and justifies introduced reasoning complexity by contraction of material interpretation alternatives. Rival authority, failure-classification and evidence uncertainty count only where they leave distinct semantic/authority/outcome/acceptance readings and are not independent benefits. Detailed algebra/Ontology/IACS/Prime/views can be proportional; a short duplicate truth carrier can be disproportionate. One coherent constraint family may be justified once without clause-level rationale fields, receipts or repeated audits. Divergent implementation paths, runtime states, tests/reviews/joins are counterfactual evidence of alternatives, not an independent numerator. A bounded symbolic model resolving those alternatives within capacity is proportional at design altitude; a prior design removing none remains disproportionate. Duplicated truth, added reconciliation or larger reasoning surfaces without material ambiguity reduction are disproportionate; existing obligations should absorb detail where ownership/meaning are preserved. Repeated acquisition/context assembly/hashing/activation/status/review/evidence work serves an identified change, decision or assurance need; exact applicability/invalidation govern reuse and repetition supplies neither validity nor independence. Material operational impact requires UP-019 qualification, not universal quotas or a new accounting carrier. Priority considers current outcome, likelihood, impact, reversibility, dependency and delayed-feedback cost; probability waives no authority/integrity/safety/retained release claim/hard stop. Default priority exposes/advances the smallest supported Product path and highest-value likely failures. Displacing defensive/prerequisite work identifies claim, evidence, bounded effort, return condition and expected consequence; this is no fixed global schedule.
constraints.uncertainty: No numeric proportionality function or resource quota is supplied or inferred.

conditions: Construction is delegated to a probabilistic or agentic worker.
exceptions: An optional profile adds duties only where adopted.

grounding.quote:
When construction is delegated to a probabilistic or agentic worker, the
method governs the execution relation without prescribing the worker's model,
prompt, tools, internal search, process topology, repository layout, or
orchestration runtime.

constraints.statement: Governing authorities select outcome, delegation and required independent assessment. Human, machine and mixed bindings preserve the same affected obligations. Candidate bytes do not establish cone preservation; continuation retains useful work and observes current state including unresolved effects; bounded steps preserve affected outer relations. Construction or passing assessment cannot appoint acceptance authority. The source's normative sequence is an execution relation, without prescribing worker topology, internal search, model, prompt, tools, repository layout or orchestration.
constraints.uncertainty: The work/recovery specialization and detailed foundational derivation are outside supplied text.

conditions: For the proposed bounded action.
Design Module Method supplies additional inputs where applicable.
constraints.statement: Apply the referenced Contract application to an execution binding naming selected outcome/prerequisite/admitted experiment, bounded affected relations/invariants, accepted transformation-admission relations, computational/common-library dispositions, construction/assessment authority and upstream re-entry conditions. Acquire the constraint surface and material subject for current A, admitted Z, bounded transition and required observations. Where Design Module Method applies, consume UP-017 bounded-frame conservation, UP-016 transformation-admission completeness, UP-018 invariant reconstruction sufficiency and UP-019 computational-realization projection; do not create a second design package.
constraints.uncertainty: Referenced transformation and design laws are not supplied.

grounding.quote:
Unrelated incompleteness outside the cone is recorded as repricing input and
does not block the bounded claim.

constraints.statement: Use the smallest coherent causal dependency cone capable of selected behavior while preserving every affected governing relation. Apply Support to its material seams rather than artifact boundaries. Record unrelated external incompleteness as repricing input without blocking the bounded claim.
constraints.uncertainty: The referenced Support condition is not supplied in full.

exceptions: No renewed human ceremony is needed at every transition when basis, cone, decision envelope and re-entry conditions are accepted, except where direct-human Product/release acceptance remains required.

grounding.quote:
Direct entry preserves execution-contract admission,
the smallest lawful carrier, required assessment and reserved decisions. It
permits bounded work and condition-based result recording, not self-acceptance
at a boundary owned elsewhere.

constraints.statement: Constructor owns bounded implementation/self-review. Wherever independent assessment supports promotion, assess exact live realization under computational binding, authority paths, proof and installed subject; constructor summaries are insufficient substitutes. Selected configuration binds actors under independence conditions without a fixed actor count. Governing authority declares whether a bounded proxy may accept preservation, require local repair, reject violations and advance already-authorized actions; proxy cannot change Product meaning, requirements, authority or accepted design, which require owner re-entry. A capable context with existing sufficient work authority, exact intake and operation grant may directly become constructor/Writer without Executive activation solely to appoint it. Coordination is selected for material contexts/authority/capability/independence, never by role name alone; direct entry retains contract admission, smallest lawful carrier, assessment, reserved decisions and no self-acceptance of others' boundaries. One bounded grant may cover declared construction/status/checkpoint sequence; record actual role transitions in existing carrier. Status change alone needs neither a fresh grant nor rehash of unchanged subject. Material operation/subject/territory/authority/validity changes require resolving affected binding before effect. Executive mutation restrictions remain applicable.
constraints.uncertainty: Executive mutation restrictions and shared independence conditions are referenced but not supplied.

grounding.quote:
| `local_repair`, inadequate proof | missing or defective proof leaves the candidate claim undecided; the evidence supports a local proof repair | `indeterminate` |
| `re_enter`, defeated candidate | the intended candidate cannot satisfy an interpretable current contract without an owning-layer change | `falsified` |
| `re_enter`, unusable governing basis | the governing requirements cannot supply a coherent interpretation for this assessment | `invalid_basis` |

constraints.statement: On exact cone-preservation claim: accept with closed cone and all affected relations preserved maps satisfied; local_repair with demonstrated defect and coherent law maps falsified; local_repair with undecided implementation and supported proof repair maps indeterminate; re_enter for a candidate unable to satisfy interpretable law without owner change maps falsified; re_enter for incoherent governing interpretation maps invalid_basis; reject for violation or undisposed competing truth path maps falsified. Any label lacking required condition/reason/support is indeterminate unless independent evidence decides, retaining raw domain label as non-deciding support, counterevidence and scope/basis diagnoses. Verdict does not select remedy; supported cause and authority are separately required and useful authorized repair is not forbidden. Governing-requirement coherence is admission; candidate/design alignment is evaluated. Contradictory design alone does not invalidate interpretable requirements; proof failure can falsify proof without falsifying implementation. Candidate availability is separate. Applied disposition uses a separate exact-subject/basis/mandate decision predicate: lawful reject may satisfy decision without candidate counterexample and cannot overwrite assessment. Global correctness preserves every affected global relation, not a whole-Product proof per action. Repeated rejection at an unchanged boundary requires reassessing frame altitude, cone, common components, design/code placement and authority sufficiency; no count threshold, fixed review rounds or state machine is prescribed, but unchanged failed construction cannot be repeated as though iteration closes it.
constraints.uncertainty: The full Dispose and core conjunction contracts are not supplied.

exceptions: Whole-candidate qualification occurs earlier than its declared boundary when affected risk, uncertain impact, or a mandatory gate requires it.

grounding.quote:
A durable or reconstructable authority claim is not established solely by a
same-process proof when loss of incidental process state is a material
counterexample. Proof must destroy or exclude the incidental authority and
compare reconstructed semantic outcomes.

constraints.statement: Reviewable transitions identify exact candidate, affected relations, changed realization paths, added/removed authority paths, retained/open seams, focused and required integration proof, explicit non-changes, proposed disposition and separate applied decision. Consumers choose representation; the read model is not specification/design/admission authority. Focused proof selection binds affected source obligations, assertion/execution dependencies, supported exclusions, newly uncovered cases and mandatory gates under change-impact and risk laws. It must support intended claim: cheap falsification of weaker conditions cannot close stronger ones. Retain applicable evidence on its original subject with required new applicability relation; compare selection and reassessment cost together. Whole-candidate qualification stays at its declared boundary unless earlier required. When loss of incidental process state materially challenges durable/reconstructable authority, same-process proof alone is insufficient: destroy/exclude incidental authority and compare reconstructed semantic outcomes.
constraints.uncertainty: Referenced proof-selection and observation laws are external.

grounding.quote:
An ordinary restart selects no rebuild from the original A.
If a proposed recovery instead discards or rebuilds work, identify why repair
of retained work is insufficient, which obligations and evidence survive,
which causal assumptions change and which existing operation grant permits
that effect. Reconstructability alone does not select reconstruction.

constraints.statement: Acceptance binds one exact checkpoint and permits the next already-authorized bounded action without renewed human approval, without enlarging outcome or cone. Preservation checkpoints under exact existing grant identify parent/predecessor, territory, concurrent-writer disposition and durable evidence; they are not acceptance/promotion/publication. Apply Currentness to continuation, retaining applicable partial work/evidence. Ordinary restart does not reset to original A. Discard/rebuild recovery states why retained repair is insufficient, surviving obligations/evidence, changed causal assumptions and permitting existing grant. Reconstructability alone does not select rebuilding. Accepted material movement is progress under UP-013; churn alone proves neither movement nor noncompliance. Newly discovered distance revises forecasts, not negative implementation progress. Paperwork/code volume/test/commit/review counts alone are not progress; categories are not a numeric algorithm. Protocol counterexamples include unreconstructable execution context, constructor report replacing required independent live evidence, proxy overreach, unrelated incompleteness blocking closed cone, same-process proof for material cross-process authority, or rejected activity reported as accepted progress.
constraints.uncertainty: No checkpoint or continuation is actually accepted or executed.

exceptions: Participating owners may use a design-declared coherent composite basis instead of equal bases.

grounding.quote:
Derivation and validation bind one exact admission-valid authoritative basis
identity through admission. If validity or currentness can advance after
preflight, admission remains conditional on the declared predecessor and
currentness law for that basis or re-enters derivation and validation without
effect. Participating owners bind an equal basis or a design-declared coherent
composite basis. Independently valid judgments without that relation cannot
establish admission; retain the basis or join diagnosis under the map below.

constraints.statement: Each admission owner independently derives and validates the complete material participant/join universe from authoritative inputs. Material mutation, rollback, changed authority/basis, expired validity, or crossing an actual trust boundary require applicable validation before reliance/effect; trust crossing triggers it even for unchanged claims. Assertions, prior admission, or unsupported success establish no truth; reuse retains owner responsibility and separately required independent judgment. Bind one exact admission-valid basis through admission. Possible post-preflight advancement requires a predecessor/currentness commit condition or effect-free re-derivation/re-validation. Equal or declared coherent composite owner bases are required; independent validity alone is insufficient. Validate every participant/join before any effect. One semantic commit admits the complete transition or none on failure/interruption, never a subset/nested constituent. Internal order, lawful reuse, implementation mechanism and participant count are not prescribed. Direct/supported composite/nested boundaries preserve this law; partial results cannot replace owner derivation, competing same-scope paths cannot establish transition, and same-basis fresh reconstruction/replay reproduces exact relation/basis/outcome or refusal. Admission satisfaction, commit and atomicity remain separate. Report not_started only when no requested effect began; retain actual partial/reverted/unknown effects. Observed subset falsifies complete-or-none publication despite successful preflight; unobserved publication remains unresolved and needs observation before dependent re-entry. Refusal cannot erase effects. Omitted participants/seams, asserted completeness, unidentified/stale/incoherent basis, unguarded advancement, premature effects, exposed subsets, reconstruction differences and competing same-scope authority falsify the law.
constraints.uncertainty: Authoritative inputs, concrete joins, composite design, and runtime effects are not supplied.

grounding.quote:
| complete relation, every applicable condition and material join established | `satisfied`; supports the assessed `admitted` outcome, not proof of commit |
| forged identity/authority, stale predecessor, defeated grant, omitted required participant or join, or another demonstrated violation of an interpretable relation | `falsified`; retain the specific refusal/re-entry reason |
| unresolved enclosing ambiguity, missing support, undecided currentness or missing required reason | `indeterminate`; no guessed completeness or authority |
| uninterpretable/contradictory governing subject or basis, including mixed owner bases with no interpretable admitted composite | `invalid_basis`; retain the mixed-basis refusal diagnosis |
| evaluation outside its bound scope or capability | `out_of_frame`; the wider obligation remains open |

constraints.statement: On 'exact candidate satisfies complete declared transition at current authoritative basis': complete conditions/material joins established gives satisfied supporting assessed admitted, not commit; demonstrated interpretable violation including forgery, stale predecessor, defeated grant or omitted participant/join gives falsified with refusal/re-entry reason; unresolved ambiguity/support/currentness/reason gives indeterminate; uninterpretable/contradictory subject/basis, including uninterpretable mixed-owner composite, gives invalid_basis; evaluation outside scope/capability gives out_of_frame with wider obligation open. For interpretable composites, incompatible established participant/join is falsified and missing join evidence indeterminate; difference between valid bases is no failure when coherent composition holds. Conjunction retains authenticated failures alongside uncovered/invalid contributions. Supported arbitrary predecessors and direct/composite/nested forms share the contract. Unsupported-form not_applicable separately evaluates exclusion from design-supported boundary: supported exclusion satisfied, supported inclusion falsified, unresolved applicability indeterminate, retaining basis/scope diagnoses. It cannot replace admission assessment. Authorized admission/refusal/re-entry decisions have separate predicates; assessment grants no decision authority.
constraints.uncertainty: The complete shared conjunction mechanism is an unresolved external dependency.

conditions: For every accepted-design admission owner and supported boundary, under its supported input/state/operating/threat model.
exceptions: Representative atomic-failure observations suffice only with a design-declared dominance/equivalence proof covering the complete partial-failure surface.

grounding.quote:
For an indivisible commit unit, the atomic test establishes that boundary and
observes failure immediately on both sides. Final-participant validation
failure does not substitute for post-validation atomic-failure evidence.

constraints.statement: An excluded threat alone creates neither acceptance predicate nor defensive-work duty; expansion returns to owner, while supported malformed/stale/effect checks remain. Cases return their actual admission/applicability/publication predicate without a new conjunction or no-effect inference from refusal. Observe: direct complete relation derived/validated/admitted once; supported composite/nested constituents and owners obey same law, unsupported forms have design-grounded not_applicable and no competing/weaker path; reachable forged identity/membership/equality/authority refused without effect, exclusion by owner rather than helper incapacity; unresolved enclosing identities/joins/seams refused without effect; stale input refused and advancement triggers effect-free re-entry; incoherent multi-owner basis retains invalid_basis or defeated/undecided interpretable join result, withholding admission and checking no effects; competing same-scope authority cannot establish transition; fresh reconstruction and exact replay reproduce full relation/basis/outcome/refusal. After successful validation, observe failure/interruption at every materially distinct commit/publication boundary capable of subsets, then reconstruct complete-or-none. For indivisible commits establish boundary and observe immediately both sides; final-participant validation failure is not post-validation atomic proof. Omitting owner/boundary, uncovered partial-failure boundary, weaker helper/manufactured refusal, or incomplete semantic reconstruction comparison falsifies standing qualification.
constraints.uncertainty: No accepted design, supported threat model, case execution, or coverage proof is supplied.

conditions: A change alters a load-bearing contract, carrier, resolver, provider, projection/closure law, or other shared interface depended on by multiple surfaces.

grounding.quote:
- change the authoritative core contract first
- ban bridge code for that contract family as an authoritative surface
- audit every producer and every consumer of the impacted interface
- migrate each producer and consumer to the new contract
- chase every downstream effect until no superseded closure law remains
- run complete migration-closure proof only after the migration wave is
  complete; bounded Product-slice proof remains governed by the path-relative
  promotion rule below

constraints.statement: Handle the work as constitutional migration rather than ordinary incremental patching. Change authoritative core first, disallow authoritative bridges for that family, audit and migrate every producer/consumer, follow downstream effects until superseded closure law is gone, and defer complete migration-closure proof until the wave completes while preserving lawful bounded-slice proof. Mixed old/new producers, differing runtime/reporting carriers, authoritative compatibility aliases, independent projection truth, or green tests over split architecture cannot be declared complete. Fundamental re-adoption belongs to human Product authority; explicitly disjoint compatibility retains lawful latitude. Supersession is not an automatic deletion rule.
constraints.uncertainty: The referenced preservation contracts are external.

exceptions: Safe lawful bounded evolution is a rebuttable presumption only when both strategies are lawful/feasible and the predecessor can reach the admitted outcome without competing or ambiguous authority.
Residual superseded material can be deferred only under the stated path-exclusion or disjoint-scope conditions.

grounding.quote:
Product-slice promotion and complete migration closure are distinct claims. An
intermediate Product outcome may be promoted while its enclosing migration
remains open only when the outcome's acceptance path has singular authority and
the residual implementation satisfies the deferment rule above.

constraints.statement: Use Inside-Out for in-place same-line source replacement, including core-interface bounded evolution; Fundamental Re-Adoption for intentionally re-derived major changes to runtime/carrier/type/substrate/realization basis, with predecessor demoted to reference. Prefer feasible lawful evolution preserving accepted semantics/feedback unless rebutted; this neither perpetuates unsafe/inadmissible paths nor preserves mechanisms expressly superseded by Product authority. Re-adoption requires explicit affected-Product human selection comparing value, feedback latency, authority risk, reversibility, total cost and retained semantics, plus bounded abort/re-entry condition; scale/preference alone is insufficient. Neither strategy permits proxy partial implementation in acceptance, silently authoritative bridges/fallbacks, or competing authority on a promoted outcome. Acceptance path is full causal closure of all relevant entrypoints/producers/consumers/resolvers/fallbacks/state/events/projections/proof, not one successful trace. Old/new admissibility for the same request/fact/identity/state/projection blocks promotion. Residual material outside promoted path may be deferred only if explicitly non-authoritative for it or governing explicitly specified disjoint Product/compatibility scope with deterministic routing, unable to falsify current/retained claims, and bearing bounded migration/qualification/release disposition. Tests are proof/leak detectors, not plans. Intermediate slices may promote only with singular full-path authority and lawful residual deferment; they do not close migration or waive retirement. Slice identity/criteria include Product and every causally applicable live requirement/design/retained predecessor claim, which ticket/review wording cannot narrow. Active migration does not renew accepted-slice growth: already-admitted removal/demotion/closure proof may continue without more progress claim, but material producer/consumer growth needs another live UP-013 basis.
constraints.uncertainty: No strategy, Product slice, or compatibility scope is selected here.

conditions: A shared contract or carrier materially governs any listed truth or execution boundary.

grounding.quote:
- runtime closure
- reporting or status truth
- topology or frame progression
- proof or qualification outcome
- event or projection semantics
- identity or binding resolution
- provider or resolver behavior

constraints.statement: Core-interface applicability includes runtime closure, report/status truth, topology/frame progression, proof/qualification, event/projection semantics, identity/binding resolution and provider/resolver behavior; a change capable of altering how multiple surfaces decide current truth qualifies.

conditions: Every core interface migration.

grounding.quote:
Temporary scaffolding is lawful only if it is explicitly non-authoritative and
scheduled for removal before closure.

constraints.statement: Explicitly declare exact affected scope; every excluded/disjoint Product or compatibility scope and deterministic routing; new authoritative contract; superseded contract/surface; new closure law; full old/new producer and consumer sets; and every derived projection/report/status/proof surface. Classify every old path as remove, replace, re-authorize, or temporary scaffolding. Scaffolding is lawful only when explicitly non-authoritative and scheduled for removal before closure.

conditions: A core interface migration.
exceptions: An intentionally specified, explicitly bounded compatibility feature retained in the live Product and clearly identified as compatibility rather than current native truth.

grounding.quote:
The only lawful exception is an explicit compatibility feature retained as part
of the live product. In that case the compatibility path must be:

- intentionally specified
- explicitly bounded
- clearly identified as compatibility rather than current native truth

constraints.statement: No authoritative compatibility alias, silent fallback identity law, bridge posing as new-contract acceptance, old reader/writer authoritative for an outcome governed by the new contract, or proxy/partial implementation posing as completion may remain, subject only to the explicit live-Product compatibility exception.
constraints.uncertainty: The exception must also meet applicable disjoint-scope and singular-authority rules elsewhere in the supplied migration family.

conditions: Runtime, reporting, status, topology, and proof views of the authoritative carrier.

grounding.quote:
A different carrier or closure law that permits conflicting
determinations, a view that independently closes an open source, or a view
retaining superseded closure law leaves the migration incomplete, even when the
authoritative carrier itself can close.

constraints.statement: Apply faithful projection with one governing closure relation across all views. Conflicting carrier/closure determinations, independently closing an open source, or retained superseded closure law keep migration incomplete even if the authoritative carrier closes.
constraints.uncertainty: The complete faithful-projection contract is not supplied.

conditions: Inside-out hard-break migration.
exceptions: Downstream exploration may exist as isolated non-authoritative work before source-carrier admission/publication.

grounding.quote:
- a downstream projection ticket must not close while the source-carrier ticket
  it depends on is still open
- dependency direction must reflect this order explicitly so the ticket set
  exposes the migration wave from source truth to downstream read models

constraints.statement: Proceed outward from new authoritative source. Before using proof as closure evidence discover the full best-guess interface family, including producers, consumers, projections, prompts, reports, wrappers, replay/ingest/bootstrap paths and proof surfaces. Producer/source-carrier work precedes downstream consumer/projection/prompt/dossier/report/review hardening. Isolated exploration cannot land in public runtime/projection/prompt/report/proof entrypoints before source carrier is published and admitted. Dependent projection tickets cannot close while source-carrier tickets remain open; ticket dependency direction explicitly exposes this order.
constraints.uncertainty: The source calls discovery best-guess, without making it a proof of inventory completeness.

conditions: Each break in an inside-out interface-family migration wave.
exceptions: Explicitly specified, deterministically routed, non-overlapping Product or compatibility scopes may coexist while migration remains open.
Newly discovered interfaces leave the wave only through explicit upward repricing.

grounding.quote:
1. publish or admit the new deepest authoritative source carrier
2. deliberately sever one old authoritative seam
3. keep that seam broken
4. repair outward from source truth to consumers, then projections, then
   prompts/reports, then proof surfaces
5. run negative proof that the severed seam is rejected rather than merely
   unused

constraints.statement: Publish/admit deepest new source; sever one old authoritative seam and keep it broken; repair outward to consumers, projections, prompts/reports, then proof; negatively prove severed-seam rejection, not mere non-use. A migration wave is ordered breaks, not permission for ambiguous dual authority over identical requests/facts/identities/state/projections. Tests may reveal missing interfaces but cannot replace inventory. New affected interfaces remain in the wave absent upward repricing. Restoring the old seam through wrappers, fallbacks, projections or prompts is a defect.

conditions: Core interface changes.
exceptions: Bounded Product-slice proof may establish only the exact lawful intermediate outcome under path-relative promotion.

grounding.quote:
Complete migration-closure proof is not valid while producers and consumers
are split across old and new contracts. Bounded Product-slice proof may establish
only the exact intermediate outcome permitted by the path-relative promotion
rule; it cannot establish migration closure.

constraints.statement: Complete migration-closure proof is invalid during old/new producer-consumer split and belongs after migration. Bridge-dependent passing tests do not count, and local green tests do not override split architecture. Per-break proof must establish old-seam rejection or fail-closed behavior before downstream hardening counts as progress; intermediate slice proof cannot close migration.

conditions: Across the declared affected scope.
exceptions: Retained superseded mechanisms may serve distinct supported responsibilities with explicit justification.
An enduring cold reconstruction route or independent test oracle need not have an invented expiry.
constraints.statement: Closure requires every authoritative producer writing and consumer reading the new contract; superseded authority retired unless distinctly justified; all projections downstream of one truth; runtime/reporting/topology/proof sharing closure law; and no temporary scaffolding in acceptance. Otherwise the wave remains active, not a completed refactor. Each retained superseded mechanism names supported obligation, owner, purpose, scope and material cost; temporary compatibility/comparison has expiry/removal trigger. Existing tests, oracle label or nominal demotion cannot justify duplicate production responsibility. Surviving obligations name surviving owners; absent governing obligation requires no replacement guard. Retirement inside a closed cone need not await unrelated whole-Product closure. An accepted intermediate slice names its closed slice, visibly keeps enclosing migration open, and does not project slice acceptance as migration, qualification or release closure.

grounding.quote:
The immutable
cut bounds the feature set accepted at that point and belongs to release
metadata and evaluation. Active constitutional and shared realization surfaces
describe current truth by role, boundary and status rather than release-line
branding. Release criteria, publication and advancement remain Release Method's
decisions.

constraints.statement: Use Release Method's identity and adoption relations to bind an exact operative cut, distinct from discovery. Its immutable identity bounds the then-accepted feature set in release metadata/evaluation. Active constitutional/shared realization truth uses role, boundary and status rather than release-line branding. Release Method retains criteria, publication and advancement decisions.
constraints.uncertainty: Release identity, selector, adoption, publication and advancement rules are not supplied.

grounding.quote:
This evidence family assumes F1–F4 and F6: a witness establishes only its bound
property, and changed evidence does not author changed meaning or permission.

constraints.statement: A witness establishes only its bound property; changed evidence creates neither changed meaning nor permission. Construction assurance owns obligation→assertion→observation→supported conclusion; Contract application binds operation and Faithful projection binds views. UP-001 selects proof-target and weaker-property exclusion, UP-008 separate semantic/evidence/projection bindings, and UP-022 assurance boundary/fresh-constructor/exposure policy. Claim owner supplies target and scope; evaluator supplies evidence, never a substitute target.
constraints.uncertainty: The cited shared contracts and foundational premises are external.

conditions: A load-bearing proof.

grounding.quote:
Before selecting that witness, bind its relation to the claim, the nearest
weaker excluded property and the falsification condition. Missing these
relations leaves evidence discovery, not closure-grade proof.

constraints.statement: Bind witness reliance to exact subject/property/basis. Before choosing a witness, identify claim relation, nearest weaker excluded property and falsification condition; without them evidence remains discovery, not closure-grade. State supported necessary/sufficient relationship, required conjunction, and distinguishing observation. Interpretive fidelity and observed checker behavior remain separate target obligations. Packaging, syntax, compilation, file presence, invocation or local behavior cannot substitute for semantic, authority-bearing, installed, release or end-to-end proof merely because easier to measure.
constraints.uncertainty: Assertions and observations and Contract application are referenced externally.

grounding.quote:
Evidence or view changes do not themselves change meaning. Semantic change
requires lawful re-entry and invalidates affected downstream acceptance; a
broad digest may conservatively invalidate review without proving that every
semantic relation changed.

constraints.statement: Apply Currentness to verdict and Faithful projection to view. Evidence/view changes alone do not alter meaning; semantic change requires lawful re-entry and invalidates affected downstream acceptance. Broad digest changes may conservatively invalidate review without proving every semantic relation changed.
constraints.uncertainty: Exact shared Currentness and projection contracts are external.

exceptions: Expected/reference outcomes are optional non-authoritative evidence when they exist and apply; equivalence to them is required only by the governing basis.
Withholding before freeze applies wherever exposure would compromise reconstructive independence.

grounding.quote:
Byte or structural identity, unique derivation, determinism, and
incumbent equality are not generic comparison criteria. A construction outside
the declared competence or configuration envelope cannot indict generic method
sufficiency.

constraints.statement: Assurance reliance covers the authoritative composite subject; single-carrier evidence leaves cross-carrier obligations open. Mechanical enforcement names an executable/reproducible predicate and ordinarily reachable witness; planned/specification-only harnesses are planned evidence. Until predicate and witness are observed, the claim stays open or explicitly downgraded. Quantifier/population/scope cannot exceed evaluated evidence; generalization needs declared inference, comparable population, counterexample treatment and governing evidence. Later counterevidence invalidates dependent verdicts until superseded/withdrawn/requalified. Generic method qualification consumes Probabilistic Work Boundary, UP-020, Reconstruction Litmus, independent assessment and UP-007 trace/promotion law. Declare constructor competence/capability/context/configuration and ordinary inputs, evaluator independent authority/basis/predicate; withhold material reference outcomes, exemplars/incumbents, author memory and ad hoc rescue before freeze where independence would be compromised. After freeze compare against mandatory governing semantic basis under independently authorized evaluation, not constructor authority or a comparator adjusted after seeing output. Lawful alternate construction can satisfy semantic conformance with evidence; subjective similarity, bytes/structure, unique derivation, determinism and incumbent equality are not generic proof. Out-of-envelope construction cannot indict generic method sufficiency. Post-exposure revisions are declared interventions, qualified method constituents or new subjects, never retroactive passes. No actor type/count, review rounds, engine, prompt or orchestration is mandated. Changed derived guidance is qualified against source-derived expected behavior including permissions/exclusions/invalidators; native-use claims require ordinary actor entry/context. Digests/indexes prove identity/structure, not fidelity/usability. Mechanical/operational claims need their own observations and applicable UP-019 assumptions. Weaker/composite-mismatched evidence, unobserved enforcement, overgeneralization, undeclared inputs/envelopes/authority, compromising early exposure, omitted/adjusted semantic comparison, authoritative references or inappropriate equivalence/identity tests, and retroactive revision invalidate the law's claim.
constraints.uncertainty: Probabilistic Work Boundary, UP-007, UP-019, and foundational assessment contracts are outside supplied sections.

exceptions: Constraints, governance and verification-infrastructure requirements may need evidence in addition to or instead of end-to-end scenarios.

grounding.quote:
Without an adequate
scenario, that layer has not demonstrated the capability. A failed scenario
supplies a discrepancy to [Universal Intake Triage](#universal-intake-triage);
the failure alone does not distinguish a realization defect, inadequate
governing meaning, inaccurate prediction or an inadequate scenario, oracle or
observation. The scenario must expose operational behavior rather than merely
compare the specification's words with other words.

constraints.statement: Requirements preserve invariant truth, Design structural choice, and Scenarios operational meaning. Words in requirements/design alone do not demonstrate capabilities; adequate end-to-end scenarios expose actual behavior. A failed scenario supplies an intake discrepancy without selecting among realization defect, inadequate governing meaning, bad prediction, or deficient scenario/oracle/observation. Scenarios primarily validate capability and other operational behavior, not replace requirement categories or universally replace other evidence.

exceptions: An explicitly equivalent isolated composed-product proof lane may qualify as UAT alongside sandbox tests.

grounding.quote:
Where a product or release
claim depends on live probabilistic compute, semantic green, unit green, module
integration green, and harnessed sandbox green are necessary but not sufficient
for live acceptance.

constraints.statement: Every executable proof declares authority. SPEC_METHOD owns Product-level taxonomy in product-assurance context; Design Module Method retains module-unit law. Ticketed proof derives from admitted ticket/triage/re-entry and cited governing law, not current implementation behavior. Each lane binds expectation to owner source/justified interpretation and execution to actual subject/checker/environment/observations; labels establish neither assertion fidelity nor independent failure causes. Implementation-derived regression evidence stays local, not upstream acceptance; shared derivations may serve declared families. Design/module tests derive from design, module ownership, IACS/equivalent inventory, diagrams where present, and boundary fail-closed law; unit tests belong here, and integration/negative/fail-closed tests do when targeting module boundaries. UAT derives from requirements, acceptance criteria, scenarios, and Product release/qualification claims, and asks composed-Product satisfaction. Only sandbox/equivalent isolated composed lanes qualify. Exercise deployed/installed/runnable form through declared app/public/runtime/control surfaces under requirement-sourced scenario; source/helper/module tests alone cannot close acceptance. Harnessed sandbox exercises full path using deterministic/fake/recorded/injected results, proving composition/orchestration/control/projection/archive/wiring and supporting reproducibility. Live sandbox exercises full path with real configured external worker/tool/agent/service/transport, returning evidence through result/evaluation/provenance/projection surfaces. Claims dependent on live compute require live acceptance beyond necessary semantic/unit/module/harnessed success. A 'live' status view is not live UAT without external-boundary crossing. Different filenames/runner labels must map every executable lane to taxonomy before closure.
constraints.uncertainty: Detailed module-unit law and parallel-assurance/provenance contract are external.

exceptions: External evidence is allowed through a checked-in minimal fixture, declared source/version/acquisition-or-binding manifest, or reclassification as harnessed/live sandbox, reference comparison or optional local evidence rather than required semantic closure.

grounding.quote:
For the Product property the diagnostic is `indeterminate` when the fixture
absence leaves evidence insufficient, retaining independent counterevidence or
basis/scope diagnoses. A separately assessed `required fixture is available`
predicate may be `falsified` when absence is established. Preserve whether the
Product evaluation was undertaken; an unavailable fixture is not by itself a
Product counterexample.

constraints.statement: Required closure lanes are reproducible from declared source boundary. Unit/semantic/module-design lanes cannot depend on undeclared local paths, sibling workspaces, home directories or mutable external fixtures. External evidence requires one stated alternative. Missing fixtures fail with governed diagnostic naming authority and lane, not Product semantic failure. Product predicate is indeterminate when evidence is insufficient, retaining independent counterevidence and basis/scope diagnoses; separately established fixture absence may falsify fixture-availability predicate. Preserve whether Product evaluation occurred; unavailable fixture alone is no Product counterexample.

conditions: Every live requirement.

grounding.quote:
Every live requirement must have written testcase authority.

That authority may include scenario bundles, ordered testcase sequences, negative
or control cases, and other explicit evidence cases as appropriate to the kind of
truth being proved, but it must exist in written form and be traceable.

No live requirement is considered fully proved if it relies only on informal
operator confidence, ambient habit, or an unlabeled test corpus.

constraints.statement: Every live requirement has written traceable testcase authority appropriate to its truth: scenario bundles, ordered sequences, negative/control cases or other explicit evidence cases. Informal confidence, ambient habit or an unlabeled corpus alone cannot establish full proof.

conditions: A requirement claims meaningful system behavior.

grounding.quote:
Where a requirement claims meaningful system behavior, the proving surface should
be a scenario bundle or equivalent ordered set of testcases that exercises that
behavior through a coherent sequence rather than as disconnected fragments.

constraints.statement: Isolated assertions alone do not prove features. For meaningful behavior the proof surface should use a coherent scenario bundle/equivalent ordered testcases, showing feature/use-case boundary, proving sequence, and expected outcomes at significant steps. This is a recommendation for bundle form, not an unconditional form mandate. Scenarios pressure intent/design to name real operational boundary, sequence, actors, controls and expected outcomes, and are identified as the best source of significant code/control paths that proof must exercise.

conditions: The system has an installable or runnable development form.

grounding.quote:
Where a system has an installable or runnable development form, the decisive
proving lane runs against an installed development version as if it were an
independent project or externalized target, not only against the source tree in
place.

constraints.statement: The decisive lane exercises an installed development version as an independent/externalized target. It should prefer fresh isolated sandbox, installed/built artifact, and real declared entry/control/runtime surfaces. These preferences remain recommendations. Source/unit checks may remain useful but cannot replace installed-dev proof.

conditions: For the behavior being claimed.

grounding.quote:
If the significant paths are not declared, scenario coverage cannot be judged.
If they are declared but not exercised, the behavior is not fully proved.

constraints.statement: Declare and exercise significant meaningful paths intentionally; exhaustive proof does not require every possible branch in every file. Typical paths, where relevant, include success, rejection/fail-closed, boundary/control, integration/dispatch/transport, and recovery/retry/replay. Undeclared paths make scenario coverage unjudgeable; declared but unexercised paths leave behavior not fully proved.
constraints.uncertainty: The typical list is applicability-qualified, not an exhaustive universal checklist.

conditions: Every live requirement family.
exceptions: Paths, filenames and packaging can belong to requirements when themselves constitutional truth.

grounding.quote: Every live requirement family shall be categorized by what kind of truth it asserts.

constraints.statement: Categorize every live family by asserted truth as Capability, Constraint/Guarantee, Governance or Verification. All remain constitutional WHAT, not priority or user-facing labels. Design is structural HOW and ADRs are design forms; scenarios validate capability operational meaning. Not every requirement should become a marketed feature. Requirements should avoid premature realization choices; non-constitutional path/filename/packaging choices belong to design.

exceptions: Already accepted relations may reuse exact current basis and sufficient evidence after applicability/invalidation checks.

grounding.quote:
Reconstructability requires a correct reconstruction route, not its execution
at every use. It grants no restart authority and does not excuse stale success.
The claim determines the reconstruction span; a local selected function does
not require recreating the whole Product.

constraints.statement: Specification-driven status requires ordered reconstructability by competent teams: Goals→Intent→Product→Requirements→Design, and Requirements+Design→Realization in the selected environment. The stated 'should be able' concerns conformant sufficiency, not uniqueness. Failure to derive Intent indicates unclear/contradictory/insufficiently concrete Goals; Product failure indicates vague/contradictory/insufficient Intent; Requirements failure indicates underspecified/contradictory/non-decomposable Product; Design failure indicates underspecified/contradictory/implementation-polluted Requirements; Realization failure indicates incomplete/ambiguous/non-operational Design. ADRs/design documents supply governing realization decisions. A boundary requiring hidden major ambiguity is insufficient despite an output artifact. Reuse needs exact current basis, sufficient evidence, applicability and invalidation; reconstructability requires a route, not execution every use, grants no restart and excuses no stale success. Claim selects reconstruction span, not whole Product by default. Material counterexamples challenge affected relations. Where Design Module Method applies, its design-view coverage/material-change gate/unchanged-boundary reuse remain controlling; no waiver or recreation of unchanged accepted views follows.
constraints.uncertainty: Design Module Method coverage and material-change gates are not supplied.

exceptions: An upstream constitutional surface may already constrain technology, carrier, runtime, path, or placement.

grounding.quote: If filenames and placement are hardcoded in requirements without constitutional necessity, the requirement surface has absorbed design detail and made re-derivation harder.

constraints.statement: Requirements state required control/delivery surfaces; Design selects mechanisms and unconstrained stack/carrier/runtime. Bootstrap requirements may require authoritative surfaces, bare axioms and canonical-method routing while Design chooses entry documents, embedded blocks, standalone compiled artifacts or another lawful topology. Hardcoded filenames/placement without constitutional necessity improperly absorb design detail and impede re-derivation.

The declaration may adopt an available profile or define a project configuration.
Several agents may activate overlapping subsets; one agent may activate different frames over time.
A nominal Frame carrier may be an evaluation subject or coordinate.

Requiring a schema, axiomatic representation, prompt framework or runtime frame engine to use the method.

Adopting a template without replacing every placeholder with exact Product identities, owners, scopes, sources, grants, results and invalidation conditions and admitting the completed declaration under existing authority.
Enrolling a carrier by nominal Frame match.

grounding.quote:
An accepted Project Reference-Frame Basis may be expressed entirely as
source-linked prose. The starter at
`templates/PROJECT_REFERENCE_FRAME_BASIS_TEMPLATE.md` projects this binding
law into one copyable shape. The template is not authority and no schema,
axiomatic representation, prompt framework, or runtime frame engine is needed
to use the method. An adopting Product replaces every placeholder with its own
exact identities, owners, scopes, sources, grants, results, and invalidation
conditions, then admits that completed declaration under existing authority.

allowed: Computational bindings may use software, hardware, people, organisations or mixtures.
A calculus may be reused across tenants/environments where bindings satisfy its laws and common obligations; different language, tool or team alone need not change it.
Work-carrier bindings may resolve to directories, repository resources, tracker collections, API endpoints or Product-scoped queries.
forbidden: Defining method computation solely by machine architecture.
Weakening common obligations because an execution environment is convenient.

grounding.quote:
The binding may use software,
hardware, people, organisations or a mixture. A machine architecture is one
binding, not the definition of computation for the method.

A computational calculus may be reused across tenants and execution environments
where its bindings satisfy its laws and the common obligations. A different
language, tool or team does not by itself require a different calculus.

allowed: Projects may choose different declared ambiguity-handling policies.
Policy may permit bounded probabilistic carrying/decision or require escalation to explicit human adjudication.
Lower risk appetite may escalate more major ambiguity; higher appetite may allow more bounded probabilistic decisions.
forbidden: Omitting ambiguity or decision records under either policy.
Treating risk appetite as permission to bypass hard stops.

grounding.quote:
Projects may therefore choose different ambiguity-handling policies. A lower
risk appetite escalates more major ambiguity to explicit human judgment. A
higher risk appetite permits more bounded probabilistic decision-making. In either
case, the ambiguity and the decision must be recorded.

allowed: Internal decomposition, search, collaboration, tools and synthesis may vary when variation cannot affect governed semantic, authority, evidence, safety or release properties.
Increased capability may enlarge the bounded relation an agent can resolve.
An owning law may justify a coherent constraint family once.
forbidden: Inferring new authority, weakened invariants or waived acceptance from increased capability.
Demanding clause-by-clause rationale fields, receipts or repeated consumer audits from the one-family justification rule.

grounding.quote:
The method does not prescribe an internal decomposition, search,
collaboration, tool, or synthesis procedure when variation in that procedure
cannot affect a governed semantic, authority, evidence, safety, or release
property. Increased agent capability may enlarge the bounded relation an agent
can resolve; it does not grant authority, weaken an invariant, or waive
acceptance.

The owning law may justify one coherent constraint family once. This does not
require a rationale field, receipt, or repeated audit for every clause or
consumer application.

allowed: Implementation owners choose internal validation order and lawful reuse.
Supported arbitrary predecessor states and direct/composite/nested forms use the same contract.
Owners may bind equal bases or a design-declared coherent composite.
forbidden: Prescribing an implementation mechanism or participant count from this law.
Allowing any effect before complete validation.
Admitting participant subsets or nested constituents as transition truth.
Treating mere difference between coherently composed valid bases as failure.

grounding.quote:
Every participant and join is validated before any transition effect. Internal
evaluation order and lawful reuse are implementation-owned, but no participant
subset or nested constituent becomes admitted truth. Admission is one semantic
commit of the complete transition, bound to its exact basis identity; failure
or interruption admits the complete transition or none, never a subset. No realization
mechanism or participant count is prescribed.

limitations: This is a bounded F_P interpretation of the supplied SPEC_METHOD sections under the selected STDO 2.5.1-rc.2 basis identifier. It makes no semantic acceptance, completeness, conformance, execution, installation, qualification, or Product-instantiation judgment.

External FOUNDATION, TRANSFORMATION_LIBRARY, REFERENCE_FRAME_METHOD, baseline profile, template, DESIGN_MODULE_METHOD, TICKET_METHOD, UX_METHOD and RELEASE_METHOD content was not supplied or consulted. Referenced F1–F6, Support, Currentness, Result, Dispose, Prime, IACS, ODD and Executive restrictions are retained only to the extent described here.

The earlier recursive Product taxonomy, Probabilistic Work Boundary and other cross-excerpt definitions remain dependencies, not reconstructed authority. Shared local concepts are joined only where these supplied sections explicitly connect their meanings.

The finite schema represents source-defined judgments, traversals, transformations, result maps, temporal order and conjunction requirements as descriptive concepts, constraints and relations. It does not instantiate those operations or supply their missing operational algebra. Adapter judgment, traversal and transformation populations remain empty; this schema has no fields for them.

No concrete Product basis, actor activation, candidate, migration inventory, supported threat model, evidence collection, declared risk policy, admission or release is supplied. Conditional permissions and obligations are therefore preserved without deciding their applicability to an actual workflow.

Headings, blank lines, separators and repeated formulations are not independent semantic records. Non-normative examples are condensed into their governing categories; recommendations, optional carriers and relevance-qualified examples retain their original modal strength.
Groundings provide exact source re-entry excerpts rather than asserting that one quotation proves every clause of a consolidated record.

durable shared basis. A ticket or other authorized work instruction carries the

`TICKET_METHOD.md` defines the sprint and ticket mechanics. Domain refinements,
